title: Clarence Williams's Chicago music store
summary: They recall Clarence Williams running a music store on State Street before he went to New York.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Yes, sir. There's a man down in New Orleans now, Dave Oxley, that was in that show, told me all about it. Mm-hmm. Did you ever know Clarence Williams in New York? I guess you would have, but I knew him. I knew Clarence Williams here. Oh, when he was last right, he had the music store here.
Right down there on State Street.
He came from New Orleans, of course.
31st and State Street. I knew him here before he ever went to New York.
Of course, Jelly Roll would have known him, too.
Well, I knew him very well.
In late years, that last couple of years of Jelly's life when he was writing music, Clarence Williams was trying to sell the music there, and it was the agent.
Well, Clarence had to do good for everybody that was from Chicago, because that was kind of a syndicate.
